security_audit.summary: Most external command and path traversal alerts are false positives from markdown formatting or sibling documentation links. The skill intentionally uses Pollinations.ai network requests and includes file-writing examples, so those risks remain confirmed. No prompt injection or hidden malicious intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to send confidential prompts, private brand assets, personal data, or regulated information to the external image API.

remediation.issue: Unvalidated output file paths in examples
remediation.suggestion: Constrain generated image paths to a project output directory and reject absolute paths or parent-directory traversal before writing files.
Use unique metadata file names or check for existing files before writing generation_metadata.json.

content.value_statement: Teams need quick visual assets without account setup or paid image tools. This skill shows how to create Pollinations.ai image URLs, tune parameters, save files, and document repeatable generations.
actual_capabilities: Builds Pollinations.ai image URLs from descriptive prompts.
Documents width, height, model, seed, nologo, and enhance parameters.
Provides Python examples for downloading generated images.
Shows batch generation with multiple prompts or seeds.
Recommends metadata capture for reproducible image work.
Outlines multi-agent review steps for prompt, execution, and style checks.
limitations: Generated images depend on external service availability and model behavior.
The examples do not validate output paths before saving files.
The skill provides guidance and snippets, not a packaged local application.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Create placeholder hero images, thumbnails, and interface concepts before final design assets are ready.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Generate social banners and marketing variations with controlled dimensions, style, and seed values.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Variations
use_cases.description: Run repeatable batches for prompt experiments and store metadata for later comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a Pollinations.ai image prompt for a website hero. Include subject, style, lighting, mood, composition, model, dimensions, and seed.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Image Parameters
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for specific platform dimensions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Pollinations.ai generation plan for a LinkedIn banner. Use 1584 by 396 dimensions, recommend a model, and include a reproducible seed.

prompt_templates.title: Create Variations
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for controlled creative exploration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design four Pollinations.ai prompt variations for one product thumbnail. Keep the same model and dimensions, but vary seed, lighting, and composition.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for automation and documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a batch generation workflow for ten marketing images. Include naming rules, metadata fields, retry guidance, and review criteria.

output_examples.input: Request a 1920 by 1080 website hero image with a calm mountain theme.
output_examples.output: A generation plan with a detailed landscape prompt, Flux model, 1920 by 1080 dimensions, and a fixed seed for repeatability.

output_examples.input: Request product thumbnail variations for an app store listing.
output_examples.output: Three thumbnail directions with square dimensions, different lighting choices, and clear file names for each variation.

output_examples.input: Request a repeatable batch process for social images.
output_examples.output: A workflow covering prompt structure, seed tracking, output naming, metadata notes, and visual review checkpoints.

best_practices: Use specific prompts with subject, style, lighting, mood, composition, and quality details.
Set dimensions and seed values before generation to improve repeatability.
Save prompt, model, dimensions, seed, and output name with every generated image.
anti_patterns: Do not send private or sensitive prompt content to external image services.
Do not write generated files to broad or unreviewed paths.
Do not rely on vague prompts when brand, format, or platform requirements matter.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Pollinations.ai API key?
faq.answer: No. The documented API uses URL-based image generation without signup or an API key.

faq.question: Can I choose image dimensions?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents width and height parameters for platform-specific sizes.

faq.question: Can generations be reproduced?
faq.answer: Use the same prompt, model, dimensions, and seed to improve repeatability.

faq.question: Does the skill save files automatically?
faq.answer: It provides example Python code for saving images. Users should choose safe output paths.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I avoid sending?
faq.answer: Avoid confidential prompts, private brand material, or personal data because prompts go to an external service.
